Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Rajesh - 33 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Pallavi - 58 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Vikram - 58 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
4. Anil - 27 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The hospital ward - Day

[Rajesh is asleep in bed in the ward. Pallavi and Vikram stand near him.]

Pallavi: "What lovely weather!"

[After a long illness Rajesh passes away in his hospital bed.]

Vikram: "Rest in peace."
